notes.title: Beta 0.3.4
notes.content:
✨ New Features
 Brand new Blessing Shop feature (appears on level up)
 Character icon categories added:

   On-field/Off-field roles
   DPS/Tank/Support roles


🖥️ UI Improvements
 Completely redesigned save slot flow:

    Smoother navigation
    Can now re-open save slots from main menu

 Water Orb weapon visual effects updated

📢 Community Focus
 Blessing Shop is experimental - please share your feedback!
 Character role system prepares for future team synergies

🔧 Minor Fixes
 Fixed visual clipping on some orb effects

notes.title: Beta 0.3.3
notes.content:
✨ UI Improvements
 Enhanced Level Up screen now clearly shows: Percentage data changes (yellow highlights)
 Added weapon damage graphs accessible from Victory and Defeat screens

⚖️ Balance Changes
 Spreader (max level): Cooldown -50% Interval -50%
 Embiggen effect nerfed to 50%

notes.title: Beta 0.3.2
notes.content:
🐞 Bug Fixes
 Removed duplicate health bar Slime Boss (first step map)
 Fixed Fox Lady's rapid healing persisting indefinitely
 Adjusted High Reflector sound effects (volume/mixing)

notes.title: Beta 0.3.1
notes.content:
🛠️ Known Issues
 Save Slots × Steam Cloud currently not syncing properly (work in progress)
We apologize for the inconvenience—fixes are being prioritized!

✨ New Additions
 Added Rating, Discord, and Wishlist buttons for easier access on main menu
 Player now easier to see when hiding trees
 Trees sudden popping now fixed
 Updated visual rays on all dropped items (brighter/more noticeable)
 Added flash indicators for explosion warnings (e.g., Puffer Fish)

⚖️ Balance & Reworks
Glacial Echo (Weapon):
 Now has a cooldown system
 Picking up items reduces cooldown

Fox Lady (Character):
 Healing ultimate now rapidly restores HP (faster ticks)

Explosion Behaviors:
 Puffer Fish explosions now have a slight delay (better telegraphing)
 Embiggen calculations fixed (no more overscaling)

notes.title: Beta 0.3
notes.content:
✨ Gameplay Additions
 New Weapon: Spreader (bug projectile that chains to nearby enemies)
 New Weapon: Glacial Echo (stack-based full-screen slow/freeze)
 New Weapon: Titan's Burden (high damage/movement speed tradeoff)
 New Weapon: Ashen Pact (enhanced DoT effects)

⚖️ Balance Changes
 Scythe Boy: Bleed effects now stack up to 10
 Scythe Boy: Added "Blood Precision" buff (doubles health-based crit chance after 5s without being hit)
 Staggering Defense: Reworked to create impact AoE when hit by enemies
 Enemy AI ranged behaviour improved
 Samurai: Increased cooldown weapon by 50%

🐞 Bug Fixes
 Fixed player escaping arena when moving diagonally
 Fixed enemy hit flash effects
 Fixed status effect DoT calculations (now uses current stack count as multiplier)

🔥 Character Reworks
 Magma Girl reworked:

    Now On field main DPS
    New primary weapon: Slow-impact Meteor
    Leaves burning lava pools after explosions


🔄 System Changes
 Doodads now respawn after 120 seconds
 Health/Utility drops now despawn after 120 seconds
 Level Up UI redesigned (WIP - more PC-friendly)
 Updated support item and shared weapon icons

🎨 Visual Improvements
 Revamped Level Up UI visuals
 New weapon effect visuals
 Improved status effect indicators

notes.title: Beta 0.2.5
notes.content:
⚖️ Balance Changes
 Merchant character buffed
 Merchant now always crits during ultimate (Golden Nimbus)
 Merchant guaranteed Cloud initial movement now guaranteed towards player
 Magma abilities buffed
 Magma ultimate now explodes on every enemies that has DoT debuff
 Magma now explodes on DoT tick against enemies

✨ UI Improvements
 Fixed team character edit interface
 Fixed achievement tracking UI
 Added ray effects to dropped items (better visibility)
 Map selection now also reveals the mission

🛠️ Gameplay Tweaks
 Adjusted player collider to better match Spine animation
 Improved item drop visibility system

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.1
notes.content:
✨ New Features
 Added demo greeting UI
 Implemented save slot data UI + navigation system

⚖️ Balance Changes
 Bunny Lady active damage reduction now only activates under 50% health
 Changed Axe Lady buff/debuff to attack percent modifier
 All character cooldowns adjusted
 Player iframe reduced (0.95s → 0.25s)
 Shop melee lifesteal now has 0.25s cooldown
 Shop elemental knockback resist debuff now works properly
 Regenerative Aura healing now reduced

🐞 Bug Fixes
 Merchant can now deal damage
 Fixed bug when buying maximal upgrades
 Fixed spawn chance for Treasure Chest items
 Fixed infinity loop issues
 Fixed Deer Lady ultimate not properly removing shields
 Fixed Bunny Lady self-damage on full swing (now only consumes HP)
 Fixed reward system for KILL_COUNT quests (now drops treasure and refreshes ultimate)
 Fixed Treasure drop weapon more than maximum slot
